fishLine.method: RenderFish.doRender (bns.a(xe,DDDFF)) transcribed statement by statement from javap -c -p, in float and double as the bytecode does; the unchanged azw.a(F)/b(F) rotations, qh sin/cos table and EntityPlayer.getEyeHeight run for real. The Tessellator and GL calls are not run.

mobPush.method: javap -c -p over the unchanged classes: the "push" profiler section of EntityLivingBase.onLivingUpdate and the fields Entity.addVelocity writes. Bytecode-read, extracted mechanically; nothing is run.

effects7.method: The unchanged EntityLivingBase / PotionEffect classes drive tools/probes/Java7Map.java, a port of the OpenJDK 7u40 HashMap (spread hash, head insertion, resize in addEntry, chain-reversing transfer), swapped into the mob before any effect is put in. The port itself is recalled from the JDK 7 source, not run from a JDK 7 jar (none installed; the JDK here is 19).

dragonSound.method: javap -c -p over the unchanged classes, extracted mechanically. World.playSoundAtEntity loops the world accesses and calls RenderGlobal.playSound, which is empty in 1.7.10, so the client copy rolls the growl (random draws) and plays nothing; the sound comes from the server packet.
